sloka: स तस्या विवृते वक्त्रे वज्रसंहननः कपिः ।संक्षिप्य मुहुरात्मानं निष्पपात महाबलः ॥५-१-१९२॥
transliteration: sa tasyā vivṛte vaktre vajrasaṁhananaḥ kapiḥ ।saṁkṣipya muhurātmānaṁ niṣpapāta mahābalaḥ ॥5-1-192॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the vanara whose physique was as hard as thunderbolt suddenly contracted once again and entered her opened mouth.
